limitationTriage.limitation: Only fixed numbers of orbits; the range between about log n / log log n and typical orbit counts is not covered
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Does a known result close the bulk regime in higher rank?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: literature checked (Abdesselam typical k; Starr rank-two large deviations; Li-Starr); not attempted

limitationTriage.limitation: Monotonicity in v of the local factors K_{p,k}(v) observed numerically, not proved
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Is there a short proof of monotonicity?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: checked numerically in every computed case; Starr proves the rank-two case
limitationTriage.whyNotClosedNow: the exact values in Theorem 2.5 do not depend on it

limitationTriage.limitation: Explicit failures are not the smallest; the density at rank >= 3 is unknown numerically
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Can the first rank-three failure be found cheaply?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: greedy heuristic search; rank-two calibration against the known first failure
limitationTriage.whyNotClosedNow: search space far beyond a cheap computation

limitationTriage.limitation: Whether the limit laws are singular is undecided
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Does a known purity criterion decide it?

limitationTriage.limitation: The finite criterion first applies near 10^14 at (3,3)
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Could the conjecture at k = 3 be closed by computation?

limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Is the exact limit inferior computable?
